exposure: Disorders of mineral and lipoprotein metabolism
cohort: Children born in Canada between 2006 and 2019, including 1733 children with inborn errors of metabolism and 1,033,693 unaffected children
finding: Children with inborn errors of metabolism, regardless of whether the diagnosis was made at birth or later in life, had significantly higher risks of preterm birth, low birth weight, congenital anomalies (especially abdominal wall defects), and other adverse birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Mothers of children with inborn errors of metabolism are at risk of cesarean delivery.
